index.title: Billing
index.description: Your plan, your status and how to pay.
index.cancelAtPeriodEnd: It will be cancelled at the end of the period.
index.payHint: This opens the provider's payment page. Card details are entered there and never pass through this system.
index.portalHint: Change card, see receipts or cancel, on the provider's page.

statusHint.past_due: Access is NOT cut off for this. Suspending a company is a person's decision, not a failed charge's.
statusHint.cancelled: Cancelling deletes nothing. Your loads, invoices and documents remain yours.

provider.mockTitle: Billing is simulated on this installation
provider.mockHint: No payment gateway is configured, so pressing “Pay” charges nothing: it goes to a test page where you can simulate an accepted or a declined payment. It is there to show the whole flow before connecting the real gateway.
provider.liveHint: Pressing “Pay” goes to the gateway and charges for real.

events.title: What the provider has said
events.empty: No notice from the provider has arrived yet.
events.emptyHint: Every billing notice that arrives shows here, with whether it could be applied. This is where to look when a payment is not reflected.

done.title: Thank you
done.heading: We are confirming the payment
done.body: The provider notifies us within seconds and the subscription updates itself. You do not need to wait on this page: if you close the window, it still applies.

mock.title: Simulated payment
mock.heading: This is not a payment gateway
mock.body: This installation has no gateway configured. Here you can simulate what happens if the payment is accepted and what happens if it is declined — the second path is the one almost nobody tests and the one that hurts most.
mock.noCard: You are not asked for a card, here or with the real gateway: card details are always entered on the provider's page.

errors.unknownPlan: That plan does not exist or is not available.
